newsitem.title: UK: Chelsea Village says Middleton resigns.
newsitem.headline: Chelsea Village says Middleton resigns.

text.p: Chelsea Village Plc, the holding company that owns Chelsea football club, said on Thursday that Peter Middleton resigned as a director of the company on Wednesday evening.
Chelsea said in a statement that the company was continuing with its strategy for growth.
The company, which has been rocked by the death of vice chairman Matthew Harding in a helicopter crash on October 22, gave no further details.
Middleton is head of the European operation of the American investment firm Salomon Brothers.
